description: §52.13.2 (S449 ruling item 4) — `<program auth="Required">` (wrong case) is E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID; the value is matched exactly. Before S449 it was W-ATTR-002 and the program applied NO auth gate (measured: anonymous GET /app.html -> 200). The auth lints still do not treat it as a gate (#1234): no W-AUTH-LOGIN-MISSING / I-AUTH-REDIRECT-UNRESOLVED.
rationale: §52.13.2 as amended S449. Ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S449 "RULED — 'your recs.'" item 4 — 'Unrecognized / non-literal `auth=` (incl. `""`) = (a): compile error; amend §52.13.2 (supersedes its W-ATTR-002 + "no auth gate" SHALL).'
